Travelling abroad this December or New Year? Check when to apply for your visa.

Holiday-season appointments fill up fast. A quick guide for Indian passport holders:

• Dubai / UAE – 2–3 weeks before travel
• Singapore – 3–4 weeks before
• Japan – 4–6 weeks before
• Europe (Schengen) – 8–12 weeks before, biometrics required
• United Kingdom – 8–12 weeks before, biometrics required
• Australia – 8–10 weeks before, biometrics required
• Canada – 3–4 months before, biometrics required
• USA – as early as possible, biometrics + interview

Also check: your passport should be valid for at least 6 months after your return date.

Send us your destination and travel dates on WhatsApp and we'll share the exact document list for your case. Passport services – new, renewal, Tatkaal and minor – also available.
